Class TextWrapOptions

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.text.TextWrapOptions
public final class TextWrapOptions extends Object
Options configuring text wrapping and overflow handling.

Combines the Overflow mode (e.g. Overflow.WRAP_WORD, Overflow.CLIP) with the ContinuationIndent strategy (e.g. ContinuationIndent.HANGING, ContinuationIndent.FLUSH_LEFT).
